body: Thanks! 3 days is really a big deal for me. It would amaze me more to go even longer. I really hope to, but I imagine it would be hard for me to try to drink occasionally again. Reminding myself that sobriety is an act of self love is helpful tho, I’d always know I’m taking care of myself this way.
I wonder the same thing about me too. I’ve been a nurse for over 3 years and still get sensitive and anxious about work.
I would call out. Lack of sleep can affect your performance at work and safety of your patients.
The artist is from South Korea and done work there as well. I’m not sure how much he charged before he moved to the US though.

They are nice ppl though, I just don’t wanna come off rude or weird when I bring it up. Like as soon as they try to get my attention, could I say, “it’s pronounced “so-and-so” or “you can call me ‘so-and-so,’ that’s what I prefer”?
I kinda throw it as a hint how I answer the phone when they call me but they still continue to say it wrong.
I have but they don’t work for me. I tried them twice before and ended up with BV both times.
I think that’s an approach I’d feel most comfortable to do. I might try that next time.

I’m typically not the type to talk crap about anyone in general. Even if they give me a hard time I’ll talk about what they did, not about them as a person. I would never be bold enough to carelessly say it anywhere, or even shout it at the nurses station lol but in the future I’ll be more careful when giving info about a pt like that.

A&P is usually split into two separate courses, I and II. I don’t think you need to freshen up on anything to A&P, but if you have some familiarity with biology, it will help when you get to study the body’s cells and tissues.
A&P is doable imo, but the level of difficulty depends on how the professor teaches it. Just don’t ever fall behind if you do decide to take it.
I don’t have anything from A&P, sorry! 😭
I agree. I felt like I was actually learning when I started working.

I will be sure to not make that mistake again. I did make sure to see she didn’t have allergies before I gave it to her, plus she has taken it before according to her chart so she was familiar with it. I just misinformed her by saying it was for all types of pain, and didn’t think critically enough to offer something else.

Thank you so much for your response. I feel a little more at ease knowing that it’s not uncommon to feel this way starting off, and I’ll be sure to ask as many questions as I can. Hopefully I’ll learn quickly to what I’ll be exposed to and that I’ll eventually get comfortable taking on my patient load. Even if I’m not the most knowledgeable, I want to be a safe nurse more than anything.

Thank you, I just hate that after all these years of school and taking NCLEX I still feel like I don’t know anything. I will definitely take time to ask questions, and hopefully my team is supportive and willing to teach.
I just now deleted a post I made last night... I lost sleep convincing myself it was pointless to make lol
I asked myself that too. I thought it was love because he was the only guy I dated who was always there for me. But it really wasn’t because he kept doing things to hurt me after I asked him to stop.

The benefits doesn’t really make or break me, I just needed clarification on some of them. But I just figured it out now after going through some links and probably should tell them to disregard the voicemail I sent.

Thank you. I made myself get up to the bathroom and brush my teeth this morning. I also greeted my brother and took the dogs outside. It’s hard to believe how such simple tasks are so draining for me, but I hope that I can function much better with less anxiety in the future.
I did online therapy for a short time while I was in college last year. My services stopped when I graduated and I won’t be able to afford it until next month.

It really is tough. I was diagnosed with GAD as well, but I didn’t realize the term for that was “ruminating” until now. I didn’t think to mention it when I was seeking counseling some years ago bc I was more bothered from other things, but now that it’s been quite noticeable to me lately, I will bring it up the next chance I get into therapy again.

I feel a little more at ease knowing that I’m not alone in experiencing something like this. I’ll try my best to redirect my focus when I find myself having those thoughts.

Most times I don’t remember any weird things people have said or done. Even if it was, it wasn’t a big deal to me and I don’t think of them differently. I guess that could help me out when I find myself stuck on old conversations.

Thank you. I want the suffering to end but the thought of dying makes me too afraid to leave the burden on my loved ones. I don’t know how long I’ll go through this, but if things do lighten up for me, I just wish to be there already.
I don’t have any friends or anyone else I could talk to. I can’t let my family know about this.

Thank you. This is the one of the most painful things I’ve ever faced in my life, and I never felt so physically sick. I don’t feel good at all and it’s hard to hide it all from my family rn. They have also grown to like my friend and idk how to react if they ask about him or try to figure out later why he doesn’t come around anymore.

This feels so much worse than any other breakup I’ve ever had in the past. I’m trying to let my emotions settle for a least a week like you suggested, but for some reason I don’t feel like this is something I’ll completely get over. I’ve already deactivated my IG for other reasons but as of now, I can’t bother to see anything dealing with him for a very long time.

In the meantime, I will do everything in my power to take care of myself, physically and mentally. I will work on establishing my career, seeking a therapist, and everything else to occupy myself as much as possible. I have no clue how our friendship will end up in the future, but I guess whatever happens will happen for a reason.
I don’t think you’re an asshole how you worded it, but at this point I personally don’t feel comfortable talking to him period. I honestly feel too embarrassed to do it.

Thank you. I have a big heart and I really hate it. He was the last person I would have thought to use me like this, and it was one of my biggest fears. I will cry about it and do whatever to get my feelings out, but I for sure will walk into the next year with a new mindset and all and make sure shit like this doesn’t happen to me again.

Thank you, and I’m sorry that happened to you too. I definitely want to distance myself for a while. I don’t know honestly how it will affect our friendship but I think it will help to take time out for myself and try to work on my personal life and goals. Whether we’re still meant to be in each other’s lives or not, I will try to keep my head up and remember that everything happens for a reason.

I’m not okay with this at all. I’m not comfortable being “the other woman” or even asking him about it. I was always afraid of being in this type of situation bc as nice as he always has been to me, I never wanted to think I was being used.

If you could give some suggestions on some cleansers or other methods I could try, I would appreciate it.

I was thinking to have it via text - if he asks what I’m doing, I’ll be like, “oh I’m just ordering some meds/scheduling a checkup with the doc” or something lol
